accounting.directed_GJ: Report -dt*modify_time_factor*sum(f_gj*A) explicitly. Do not assume zero for the supplied directed geometry/controls and do not absorb it into the bath defect.

accounting.scale: Native numeric concentration/amount ledger; source scale_factor is explicitly retained in charge/current projections. No physiological calibration inferred.
accounting.source_effective: update_Co averages per-membrane environmental changes; source-effective ledger uses sum(env[j]*vol_env), equivalently M*vol_env at uniform final mean. This is an algebraic source ledger, not a physical volume reinterpretation.
accounting.standalone: No ordinary ion evolution or physical publication solve; source forces publication off and retains simulator fields. Explicit concentration/count/source ledgers stay conditional and local
